capabilities: Scan a note for media references (embeds, links, external URLs)
Browse found media in per-type tabs with counts
View media in a fullscreen lightbox with prev/next navigation
Open non-media files (pptx, docx, zip) externally
Re-scan a note with a refresh button
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT (jagajaga/obsidian-file-media-gallery) or manual download.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see all media a note references in one browsable gallery, especially when media lives at external URLs outside the vault.
summary: Media gallery that scans a note for referenced images, video, audio, and PDFs, shows them in per-type tabs with a fullscreen lightbox.
